race.comment: BORDERFALL (3) returned from a lengthy spell with a slashing on-speed victory over today's course and distance in a fast run contest. Gets every chance again and looks to have more to offer. Go close. MALUKU (1) puts an unbeaten record on the line first up at her third career start. Rounded them up with ease with the 60.5kg when saluting over 1200m at Gosford last April. Back with the two trials and maps well. ROYAL AIR FORCE (2) jumped in grade from the wide draw with a battling ninth over 1200m at Warwick Farm. Claim helps in this easier race and stays in the mix. AEGIPAN (9) tough old gelding racing well and proven at this level.
